game_input_qualification.relative_motion: Explicit script injection; not raw hardware packets.

retained_gui_failure.reason: Game relative motion rejected after focus/capture was lost between scripted actions while concurrent Windows CLI checks were active.
retained_gui_failure.assessment: External interference is plausible, not proven. Same package and unchanged harness passed in an exclusive Windows interval; no assertion was weakened.

limitations: One statically bound native library image/path per process; no NativeAOT unloading or code replacement.
C# module/state/service support remains bounded; NativeAOT retains GC/runtime services.
Exact backend comparisons cover fixtures on each OS, not arbitrary cross-platform determinism.
Windows deployment host has .NET installed; no clean-machine deployment claim.
Native Linux graphics, console publication, game-scale frame times and allocation budgets remain unqualified.
Final GUI inputs are semantic/synthetic; physical input and broad DPI/accessibility qualification remain separate.
Linux metadata fixture run omits installed-runtime export cases; Windows skips the unprivileged symlink fixture.
Read-only native headers/inventory validation does not execute code; actual module and bundle tests are recorded separately.
Path-based inspection and loading do not guarantee immunity to concurrent filesystem replacement.
Visual comparison uses a small door fixture; final door transform is directly asserted only in reference run, while bundle report exposes entry entities/gameplay fields and rendered pixels.
